ai_summary.key_headline: Team Melli's Attacking Firepower Tested by Physical All Whites Defense

iran.philosophy: Pragmatic defensive setup with reliance on Taremi and Azmoun's quality.

new_zealand.philosophy: Direct attacking focusing on crossing and aerial dominance in the box.

tactical_insights: Iran's Mehdi Taremi will drop deep to link play and drag New Zealand's center-backs out of position.
New Zealand will prioritize set-pieces and crosses, hoping Chris Wood can exploit aerial duels against Iran's defense.
The speed of Iran's wingers will challenge New Zealand's defensive transitions.
